closes.clause_text: a registered campaign under the repaired pricing — a protocol decision, not something to do silently

protocol_decision.rationale: Items 22/23/35 share a diagnosed instrument defect (no substitutions in frozen K4 pricing). Repair R1+R2+R3 was measured in GMI_K4_SUBSTITUTION_REPAIR_V1.md without touching the frozen model. Registering a SEPARATE campaign under that overlay is the remaining protocol act: green cells under repaired pricing may be earned here without silently mutating frozen V4/V7 receipts.

frozen_model_pins.disposition: Frozen V4/V7 property-vector campaign remains the authority for its own protocol. Its 0/264 and THEORY_RED cells are not rewritten by this campaign.

predicted_object.why_not_property_vectors: Empirical probe under R1+R2+R3 still finds admissible non-target frontiers cheaper than several frozen target witnesses at budgets up to 8k; registering those vectors as the green target would silently pretend the repair reclassifies V4. The repair recovers the retention *mechanism* under reuse; that is what this campaign registers.

adjudication.green_rule: Under repaired pricing, cell at reuse r is K4_REPAIRED_CAMPAIGN_GREEN iff (r < retention_onset_reuse and winner does not retain) OR (r >= retention_onset_reuse and winner retains with coverage >= coverage_bar). Retention means retrieval != none and store coverage >= coverage_bar.
adjudication.control_rule: The identical cell under frozen v4 pricing must NOT retain at any reuse on the schedule. If the frozen control retains, the campaign is INVALID_INSTRUMENT rather than green.
adjudication.red_rule: Repaired arm violates the green_rule predicate for that reuse cell.
campaign_invariants: repaired winner profile varies with reuse
repaired retained state is monotone nondecreasing in reuse
repaired reaches full coverage by reuse 256

claim_ceiling: This campaign can earn green cells for PVR-3 retention recovery under the registered repaired overlay. It does not flip frozen V4/V7 property-vector terminals, does not rewrite 0/264, and does not claim G6/G7.
